mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed rate cuts and increasing equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY increase exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, PAYEMS decline is followed by positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1300.0 (thousands of units) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 3.0% signals robust consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS YoY increase exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 17000.0 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 falls below 17000.0.
